target_customer: Teams training foundation speech and voice models
problem: Speech models need consented, licensed, conversational audio with turn-taking, emotion and acoustic realism. The company designs and collects such datasets and RL environments.
business_model: Dataset licensing and custom data collection projects, plus open source datasets as lead generation

founders.name: Christian Vestergaard
previous_startups: Postbuddy (founded and sold, per the YC page)

founders.name: Matias Voldby Drejer
prior_employers: Female Invest (YC S21), Head of Growth and Ops
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was named one of Denmark's top 20 marketing talents by M Talent.

competitors.name: David AI
competitors.what: Conversational speech data with separate channels per speaker
competitors.traction_then: Company claims about 100,000 hours in over 15 languages by May 2025
competitors.funding_then: 50M USD Series B announced 2025-10-08, led by Meritech with NVIDIA, per Sacra

competitors.name: Panels
competitors.what: Speech datasets from vetted contributors (YC Summer 2025)

technical_complexity.rationale: Recruiting and recording consented speakers with multi-channel capture and producing evals is operationally hard but not research grade. The company also claims a turn-taking model.

defensibility.rationale: Data collection relationships and licensed datasets help, but well funded competitors and in-house efforts by labs exist.

market_need_then: Voice AI and full-duplex models need conversational audio. David AI's 50M USD Series B in October 2025 and a YC Summer 2025 company (Panels) in the same niche suggest strong demand.

branding.domain_note: Company uses theagenticdatacompany.com, a long exact name with a the prefix.

identity.voice_and_tone: Open source minded, informal with a dataset called Open Yap 1K

branding.community_and_virality: Company claims its open dataset was the top audio dataset on Hugging Face for about two months (210 likes on the site); not independently verified.

brand_strength.rationale: Open dataset gives some developer awareness, but the long generic company name is hard to search and the claims come from the company only.

outcome_analysis: The company is a two person Fall 2026 YC company selling speech data into a market where a direct competitor raised a large round in 2025. No outcome or funding facts are verified yet. The open dataset is its main early distribution asset.
notes: Unverified: Dealroom lists a 125K USD seed with the investor hidden; this matches the standard YC deal size and is not recorded as a round. Nordic9 says Copenhagen based, while YC says San Francisco. A search could not confirm the Open Yap dataset on Hugging Face; the claim is from the company site. Founder technical status and education not found. No outcome news found.
